newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures ease on firmer sterling.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures ease on firmer sterling.

text.p: LIFFE wheat and barley futures eased in quiet trade with spread trading bumping up the apparent volume, traders said.
The firmness of sterling against other European currencies put some pressure on the market but there was good support at around 0.50 stg down, one said.
March/May spreading accounted for some 30 per cent of the total volume, he said.
Holders' keenness to get out of front month January helped widen the January/March and January/May spreads, he said.
January last traded 0.45 sterling lower at 94.85 stg per tonne on volume of 30 lots.
March last traded 0.35 stg lower at 97.15 stg on volume of 57 lots.
May last traded 0.35 stg lower at 99.15 stg on volume of 64 lots.
